englishAudio.text: What should we inspect first?

englishAudio.text: I inspect first. All the tools and parts Min brought are recorded.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: A ship is bringing clean water this afternoon. I want the repair finished before it arrives.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: We cannot sacrifice safety to finish early.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Are you afraid they will be disappointed?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I know. But they are still waiting.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: They need water and safety. Being careless will not help them.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I am afraid they remember me opening the water in secret and do not trust me to repair it.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Work honestly today. We cannot ask them to forget the past.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I have the Force. I can help.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I want to help. Am I being careless too?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Asking you to stop does not mean rejecting you. First, look.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I do not answer. I stop and watch patiently.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Please explain what this part does.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The two sides are not aligned. That is the problem, not a lack of Force.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: It protects the pipes. If this is wrong, the pipes will be damaged.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Strength means knowing when to stop.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I was careless. Are you still willing to work with me?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Yes. But we check first, then repair.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Breathe first. Then we can try together.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: All right. I will be patient. You can speak freely.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: It is repaired. I relied on the Force, but it turns out I still had a lesson to learn.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.
